	DHCS_JSON_FileName as string (),

	Excel_Email_Recipients as string (),

	Excel_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),

	File_Type as string (),

source(output(
		planCode as string,
		providerNPI as string,
		providerType as string,
		adultMembersServedCount as string,
		childMembersServedCount as string,
		adultMembersCanServeCount as string,
		childMembersCanServeCount as string,
		adultPOF as string,
		childPOF as string,
		Rpt_Recipient as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Rpt_Recipient, planCode, providerNPI, providerType, adultMembersServedCount, childMembersServedCount, adultMembersCanServeCount, childMembersCanServeCount,REPLACE([adultPOF], \'"\',\'\') AS adultPOF, REPLACE([childPOF], \'"\',\'\') AS childPOF FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=3',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource1	source(output(
		planCode as string,
		eligibleMemberCount as string,
		initialOutreachMemberCount as string,
		enrolledMemberCount as string,
		externalRequestMemberCount as string,
		externalRequestDeniedMemberCount as string,
		externalRequestApprovedMemberCount as string,
		Rpt_Recipient as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Rpt_Recipient, planCode, eligibleMemberCount, initialOutreachMemberCount, enrolledMemberCount, externalRequestMemberCount, externalRequestDeniedMemberCount, externalRequestApprovedMemberCount FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=2',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource2	source(output(
		planCode as string,
		cin as string,
		benefitStartDate as string,
		benefitENDDate as string,
		Rpt_Recipient as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Rpt_Recipient, planCode, cin, benefitStartDate, benefitENDDate  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=4',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource21	source(output(
		rpt_recipient as string,
		planCode as string,
		cin as string,
		benefitStartDate as string,
		benefitENDDate as string,
		adultPOF as string,
		childPOF as string,
		lastName as string,
		firstName as string,
		dateOfBirth as string,
		discontinuationReason as string,
		providerNPI as string,
		inPersonEncountersCount as string,
		teleEncounterCount as string,
		careManagerFirstName as string,
		careManagerLastName as string,
		careManagerSiteNPI as string,
		facilityId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT rpt_recipient,planCode, cin, benefitStartDate, benefitENDDate, REPLACE([adultPOF], \'"\',\'\') AS adultPOF, REPLACE([childPOF], \'"\',\'\') AS childPOF,  lastName, firstName, dateOfBirth, discontinuationReason, providerNPI, inPersonEncountersCount, teleEncounterCount, careManagerFirstName, careManagerLastName, careManagerSiteNPI, facilityId FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource3
OLEDBSource1 derive({Copy of adultMembersServedCount} = adultMembersServedCount,
		{Copy of planCode} = planCode,
		{Copy of Rpt_Recipient} = Rpt_Recipient,
		{Copy of childMembersServedCount} = childMembersServedCount,
		{Copy of providerNPI} = providerNPI,
		{Copy of adultMembersCanServeCount} = adultMembersCanServeCount,
		{Copy of childMembersCanServeCount} = childMembersCanServeCount,
		{Copy of childPOF} = childPOF,
		{Copy of adultPOF} = adultPOF,
		{Copy of providerType} = providerType) ~> DataConversion1
OLEDBSource2 derive({Copy of Rpt_Recipient} = Rpt_Recipient,
		{Copy of enrolledMemberCount} = enrolledMemberCount,
		{Copy of externalRequestApprovedMemberCount} = externalRequestApprovedMemberCount,
		{Copy of planCode} = planCode,
		{Copy of eligibleMemberCount} = eligibleMemberCount,
		{Copy of initialOutreachMemberCount} = initialOutreachMemberCount,
		{Copy of externalRequestMemberCount} = externalRequestMemberCount,
		{Copy of externalRequestDeniedMemberCount} = externalRequestDeniedMemberCount) ~> DataConversion2
OLEDBSource21 derive({Copy of planCode} = planCode,
		{Copy of cin} = cin,
		{Copy of benefitENDDate} = benefitENDDate,
		{Copy of benefitStartDate} = benefitStartDate,
		{Copy of Rpt_Recipient} = Rpt_Recipient) ~> DataConversion21
OLEDBSource3 derive({Copy of careManagerFirstName} = careManagerFirstName,
		{Copy of teleEncounterCount} = teleEncounterCount,
		{Copy of adultPOF} = adultPOF,
		{Copy of facilityId} = facilityId,
		{Copy of benefitENDDate} = benefitENDDate,
		{Copy of cin} = cin,
		{Copy of careManagerLastName} = careManagerLastName,
		{Copy of dateOfBirth} = dateOfBirth,
		{Copy of benefitStartDate} = benefitStartDate,
		{Copy of planCode} = planCode,
		{Copy of providerNPI} = providerNPI,
		{Copy of inPersonEncountersCount} = inPersonEncountersCount,
		{Copy of rpt_recipient} = rpt_recipient,
		{Copy of discontinuationReason} = discontinuationReason,
		{Copy of firstName} = firstName,
		{Copy of childPOF} = childPOF,
		{Copy of careManagerSiteNPI} = careManagerSiteNPI,
		{Copy of lastName} = lastName) ~> DataConversion3
